description: Lightweight .NET MAUI controls with SkiaSharp drawing. Includes SkiaCalendarView (single/range date selection, month and year pickers), SkiaToggleButton (single/multiple selection, custom Content and alignment), SkiaComboBox (drop-down list and manual entry), SkiaInputBox (typed values in a native field), SkiaSelectorView (multiple choice with Select all and Clear), SkiaGalleryView (swipeable images), SkiaZoomView (zoomable picture with movable items), SkiaProgressBar and AnimatedBackgroundControl. Toggle and gallery controls also work inside SkiaCollectionView item templates.
releaseNotes:
0.1.0-rc.2.10: New SkiaInputBox: a field drawn like SkiaComboBox (same appearance properties and height) that edits a typed value in a native Entry: Input (two-way) of InputType, Format while unfocused, AllowNull, a focus ring. New SkiaZoomView: a picture to zoom and pan (pinch, fling, double tap) with MAUI item views placed in its coordinates, which can be selected, dragged and resized; ZoomTo, CenterOn, ScrollToItem, FocusOn and FitToView. SkiaToggleButton adds MaxLines (wrapping text), EnableUntoggle and NeverChecked. SkiaProgressBar shows negative progress, growing leftwards in NegativeColor. AnimatedBackgroundControl eases to a stop when idle and back up on touch (SlowdownDuration) and raises FirstFrameRendered once its first frame is painted. Built on SkiaCollectionView 2.0.0-rc.2.9.

0.1.0-rc.2.9: SkiaComboBox opens immediately without a double-tap delay or popup animation. DoubleTapEnabled defaults to false: tapping an open combo closes it. When enabled, tapping the open combo raises DoubleTapped and opens manual entry unless handled; there is no timing window. The editor resizes above the keyboard in fullscreen apps. Fixed-width combos skip unnecessary item-width measurement. Built on SkiaCollectionView 2.0.0-rc.2.8.

0.1.0-rc.2.8: SkiaToggleButton adds Content (custom MAUI views, with Text/Icon fallback) and HorizontalContentAlignment; it now derives from ContentView and also renders custom content inside SkiaCollectionView templates. SkiaComboBox adds UseIcons, HorizontalAlignment, DoubleTapped and Keyboard; double-tap opens manual entry, matching existing items or storing new text in SelectedItem. Built on SkiaCollectionView 2.0.0-rc.2.8.

0.1.0-rc.2.7: built on SkiaCollectionView 2.0.0-rc.2.7 (crash fix for lists inside MAUI's CollectionView).

0.1.0-rc.2.6: UseSkiaMauiControls() also registers SkiaCollectionView's handler (lists drawn by Android's renderer). Built on SkiaCollectionView 2.0.0-rc.2.6.

0.1.0-rc.2.5: built on SkiaCollectionView 2.0.0-rc.2.5 (a gallery loading inside a list shows the list's native spinner, which doesn't repaint the list).

0.1.0-rc.2.4: SkiaGalleryView shows a spinner on a page whose picture is still loading and a crossed-out picture when its source gives no image, on a page and inside SkiaCollectionView (where it follows the list's ShowImageLoadingIndicator, ShowImageErrorIndicator and ImageIndicatorColor). Requires SkiaCollectionView 2.0.0-rc.2.4.

0.1.0-rc.2.3: built on SkiaCollectionView 2.0.0-rc.2.3.

0.1.0-rc.2.2: built on SkiaCollectionView 2.0.0-rc.2.2.

0.1.0-rc.2.1: SkiaToggleButton works inside SkiaCollectionView item templates: rows are drawn from their items, a tap writes SelectedValue (or a SkiaToggleGroup container's) into the row's item and runs Command, groups follow, a drag scrolls the list. Requires SkiaCollectionView 2.0.0-rc.2.1.

0.1.0-rc.2: First preview. SkiaCalendarView, SkiaToggleButton, SkiaComboBox, SkiaSelectorView and SkiaGalleryView (swipeable images with page indicators; inside SkiaCollectionView item templates it is baked with the row and comes alive under the finger). Requires .NET 11 / MAUI 11 RC2.
